title: TrimMask trimmed-shell IGA: revision data and CoreConsole runtime
description:
Model inputs, numerical fields, independent references, verification methods, manuscript figure panels and the AutoCAD2025 CoreConsole runtime for the TrimMask trimmed-shell IGA study.

The dataset supports retained-domain checks, interface work and graph comparisons, quadrature accuracy and timing, and displacement and physical-face stress comparisons. Main-text and response quantities are identified separately. Recorded numerical fields and runtime modules retain their actual execution families.
notes: Publicly downloadable research data/runtime. All rights reserved: https://github.com/yaluji123/TrimMask-trimmed-shell-IGA/blob/main/LICENSE. No new open-source grant. Separate Clipper2, Eigen and Intel notices remain with their components.
